title: Man Utd brutally strip 685 fans of their season tickets and warn 464 more amid controversial ticket touting crackdown
content: MANCHESTER UNITED have confirmed that 685 season tickets have been revoked amid a controversial ticket touting operation. And 464 further fans have been slapped with either a "reduced sanction" or "final warning". title: Man Utd 'remove 685 season tickets' after controversial summer crackdown
content: Manchester United have stripped 685 after an investigation into ticket touting - with the heavy-handed summer crackdown resulting in widespread condemnations from fans and supporter groups
